errors: Design conflict: The selection conditions (membership in #general; user's reaction of 👍 to the #announcements security-audit message; first name Jordan) are satisfied by two distinct users—Jordan Lee and Jordan Kim—each with their own #general membership. The request asks to remove a single specific member, but nothing in the stated conditions distinguishes between these two equally-matching memberships. Any selector that resolves to only one of them would silently impose a surname or other restriction not present in the request text, and a state-changing removal cannot be safely narrowed to an unauthorized choice between two live candidates.
